I read p.111-112 and the Lean. All three voters agree on verdict and relation; I keep both. qbig is one positive number with no stage or order argument, physicalDomain is exactly {0<q<q_big}, and stages_smooth plus physicalData give smooth uncut partial sums identified with the cycle's construction. The hypothesis hN is met by selectedThreshold_geometry, so nothing is vacuous. The only dispute is finding 1: accurate but not material, so I rule CONVENTION, not CONTENT and not REFUTED. The derivative-count clause is unstated (low coverage gap); 'partial' is defensible on that ground, but the clause is proof bookkeeping whose consequence is stated. I added physicalData and the prefix lemmas from the skeptics.

findings.summary: The derivative-count clause has no Lean statement. Lean carries all-order smooth classes through the cycle and states a finite constant for each stage and order directly, so the paper's DAG counting was not what was checked.
